attributes.title: Greater New York Dental Meeting 2026
attributes.summary:
The Greater New York Dental Meeting runs November 27 to December 1, 2026, at the Javits Center in Manhattan. The scientific program covers all five days, while the exhibit floor is open November 29 to December 1. The organizer advertises more than six hours of free CE every day, alongside paid courses and hands-on workshops.

The meeting is an ADA CERP Recognized Provider and an AGD PACE Program Provider. Credit equals the number of course hours; attendees claim it in the online CE registry with the code given in each session, and the registry stays open until March 2027. Course listings mark many sessions as recommended for hygienists as well as dentists.

Pre-registration is free until November 26, 2026, and badges are not mailed. Fees for individual paid courses are listed per course on the official site.
